changes.zh: 新增更新日誌頁，列出網站每次的更新內容。
changes.en: New changelog page listing each update to the site.

changes.zh: 新增靈魂附魔頁：靈魂腐化怪物生成時可能帶有的 12 種增益，列出 I–III 級數值、威脅等級限制與排除條件。
changes.en: New Soul Enchantments page: the 12 buffs Soul Corrupted mobs can spawn with, with tier I–III values, threat limits and exclusions.

changes.zh: 有靈魂腐化版本的怪物頁加上前往靈魂附魔頁的連結。
changes.en: Bestiary pages of mobs with a Soul Corrupted version link to the Soul Enchantments page.

changes.zh: 掉落機率加入一般怪物：裝備頁與計算器顯示各區域擊敗一般怪物與靈魂腐化怪物時掉出該物品的機率，並補上幾隻原本沒有機率的頭目。
changes.en: Drop odds now cover regular mobs: gear pages and the calculator show the chance per region from regular and Soul Corrupted mobs, and a few bosses that had no odds now do.

changes.zh: 掉落機率計算器的護甲依部位分組。
changes.en: The drop calculator groups armor by slot.

changes.zh: 寶箱來源改用站內翻譯的名稱。
changes.en: Chest sources use the site's translated names.

changes.zh: 新增掉落機率計算器，裝備頁也列出各來源的掉落機率。
changes.en: New drop calculator; gear pages also list the drop chance from each source.

changes.zh: 新增威脅與難度指南：三種難度與威脅等級 1–20 的數值。
changes.en: New Threat and Difficulty guide: the values for the three difficulties and threat levels 1–20.

changes.zh: 近戰武器、遠程武器、護甲與神器頁新增逐級詞條機率，可切換威脅等級、稀有度與風暴獎勵額外詞條。
changes.en: Melee weapon, ranged weapon, armor and artifact pages show affix odds by threat level, with rarity and Soul Storm bonus affixes.

changes.zh: 世界地圖改為遊戲內樣式，任務分為主線與支線，並新增風暴產生器、護符寶箱與地下城標記。
changes.en: The world map looks like the in-game map, splits quests into main and side quests, and adds storm generator, talisman chest and dungeon markers.

changes.zh: 地點頁的掉落物依類別分組，並補上其他來源與任務獎勵。
changes.en: Location pages group their loot by type and add other sources and quest rewards.

changes.zh: 配裝、武器比較與掉落機率計算器的物品選擇視窗改為同一套帶圖示的樣式。
changes.en: The Build Planner, Weapon Compare and drop calculator share one item picker with icons.

changes.zh: 修正配裝的附魔圖示、箭袋說明、計算器提示被標題遮住，以及靈魂風暴頁的區域圖示與產生器數量。
changes.en: Fixed Build Planner enchantment icons, the quiver description, calculator hints hidden under headings, and Soul Storm region icons and generator counts.

changes.zh: 網站公開上線，頁尾加入回報錯誤的連結。
changes.en: The wiki goes public, with a link in the footer to report mistakes.

changes.zh: 世界地圖顯示任務地點：有座標的任務直接標出，其餘依區域合併成一個圖釘。
changes.en: The world map shows quest locations: quests with coordinates get their own pin, the rest are grouped by region.

changes.zh: 附魔的取得方式補上附魔書池的地區與掉落來源，並隱藏獨特附魔。
changes.en: Enchantment sources add the regions and droppers of each book pool, and unique enchantments are hidden.

changes.zh: 武器比較改用帶圖示的武器選取器。
changes.en: Weapon Compare picks weapons from an icon grid.

changes.zh: 怪物圖片在高解析度螢幕上不再模糊。
changes.en: Mob pictures are no longer blurry on high-resolution screens.

changes.zh: 長標題不再溢出物品格線；統一全站字型，並修正多種語言的長名稱撐開版面。
changes.en: Long titles no longer spill out of the item grid; fonts are consistent across the site, and long names no longer stretch the layout.

changes.zh: 新增武器比較頁。
changes.en: New Weapon Compare page.

changes.zh: 新增任務列表與各任務頁。
changes.en: New quest list and quest pages.

changes.zh: 新增地點與頭目頁。
changes.en: New location and boss pages.

changes.zh: 新增依遊戲資料撰寫的機制攻略。
changes.en: New mechanics guides written from the game data.

changes.zh: 新增配裝頁，支援分享連結與 PNG 圖卡。
changes.en: New Build Planner, with shareable links and a PNG card.

changes.zh: 新增靈魂風暴頁與即時時程。
changes.en: New Soul Storms page with a live schedule.

changes.zh: 移除世界地圖上多出來的虛空地面。
changes.en: Removed the stray void ground from the world map.

changes.zh: 修正設計檢查找出的多處介面問題。
changes.en: Fixed interface problems found in a design review.

changes.zh: 網站擴充為 16 種語言。
changes.en: The wiki is available in 16 languages.

changes.zh: 新增世界地圖頁，使用遊戲的地圖圖磚與標記。
changes.en: New World Map page built from the game's map tiles and markers.

changes.zh: 新增怪物圖鑑，物品頁也依遊戲掉落資料列出取得方式。
changes.en: New Bestiary; item pages list where to get them from the game's drop data.

changes.zh: 新增頁首選單與成就頁。
changes.en: New header menu and Achievements page.

changes.zh: 護符頁補上說明、等級表與秘密護符標記。
changes.en: Talisman pages add descriptions, level tables and secret talisman tags.

changes.zh: 全站字體、配色與版面打磨。
changes.en: Polished fonts, colours and layout across the site.

changes.zh: 網站原型：近戰武器、遠程武器、護甲、神器、護符與附魔圖鑑，數值取自遊戲資料。
changes.en: First version: melee weapons, ranged weapons, armor, artifacts, talismans and enchantments, with stats from the game data.

changes.zh: 游標說明框與遊戲圖示。
changes.en: Cursor tooltips and game icons.
